title: ledge config
description: Window settings, passed with --config. Leave out a key to get its default.

screen.description: An index into the screens; 0 is the one with the menu bar. Default 0.

edge.description: The edge the bar runs along. Default bottom.

height.description: The bar's height in points. Default 110.

theme.description: How the bar looks. Default default, which follows the system's light or dark mode; the others always look the same. See internal/pages/themes.
